proposed.text: A restaurant/cafeteria (V = 600 m3) with hard concrete walls and ceramic tile flooring currently has RT60 = 1.8 seconds (too reverberant). Target is 0.75 seconds for controlled noise. Calculate the additional absorption (in sabins) required.
proposed.rationale: Sabine formula (SI): RT60 = 0.161 x V / A. Rearranging: A = 0.161 x V / RT60. Current absorption A_current = 0.161 x 600 / 1.8 = 53.7 sabins. Target absorption A_target = 0.161 x 600 / 0.75 = 128.8 sabins. Additional absorption required = A_target - A_current = 128.8 - 53.7 = 75.1 sabins (approximately 75 sabins). Correct answer is b. Option a (38 sabins) results from arithmetic error (e.g., dividing by 4 instead of subtracting). Option c (128 sabins) is the target total absorption A_target (not the additional amount; this is a common misreading). Option d (205 sabins) was the original erroneous marked answer and is off by a factor of 2.7 from the computed value; it would correspond to a target RT60 of 0.35 seconds (unrealistically low for a restaurant).
proposed.explanation: Additional absorption = A_target - A_current = (0.161 x 600 / 0.75) - (0.161 x 600 / 1.8) = 128.8 - 53.7 = 75.1 sabins.
